1.w: Hallelu YAH! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise Him in the heights!

2.w: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts!

3.w: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light!

4.w: Praise Him, O heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens!

5.w: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for He commanded, and they were created.

6.w: And He established them for ever to forever; He made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

7.w: Praise YHWH from the earth, sea creatures and all the depths;

8.w: fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind of storm—doing His word;

9.w: mountains and all hills, trees of fruit and all cedars;

10.w: the beast and all cattle, the creeping thing and bird of wing;

11.w: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;

12.w: young men and also maidens, old with young:

13.w: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor above the earth and the heavens!

14.w: For He has raised up the horn of His people, the praise from all His saints, from the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise YAH!
